entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi, David. I... I need to return something. I bought a pair of your cycling shoes last week and... they're just not working out. I feel terrible about it.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into the return options for you. To make sure I understand, is there a technical fault with the shoes, or is it more of a preference issue?

I guess preference? They're just so uncomfortable. I went for one ride, and they gave me horrible blisters on my heels. I tried adjusting the cleats and everything, but it didn't help. I've been a VeloFit customer for years, and this has never happened.
I see. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. I understand that's frustrating. Let me just pull up our policy here to see what we can do for you.
Oh, please. I was really hoping for a refund. I saved up for these for a while, and I really need that money back if they're not going to work. I'm just so disappointed.

Okay, I've got the policy in front of me. Let's see... Yes, it looks like our standard return window for items like cycling shoes is 10 days from the delivery date. Since you received them just six days ago, you are unfortunately outside the timeframe for a full refund.
Oh, really? That's... that's wonderful! Are you sure? I was so worried.

Absolutely. We can definitely process that for you. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return label right now. Just package the shoes back in their original box, attach the label, and drop them off at any post office. Once we receive them, the refund will be issued to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
Thank you so much, David! You have no idea what a relief that is. I really appreciate your help.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, that's all. You've made my day. Thanks again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
